ready_samples.status: 慢步 · 巡航 · 恢复体力

cases.source: real countdown, viewport-dispatched mouse events, manually stepped production Battle._physics_process; distant acted opponent is a fixture

cases.interpretation: 0.5/0.9/2-second displacement differences are measured, not arbitrary acceptance thresholds or proof of good game feel
cases.name: engine_held_from_rest
cases.source: viewport left-button press and real Battle physics from standstill; independent non-boosted model is the automatic-advance comparison

scope: GPU production scene and actual swept contacts, inherited v049 first-frame/audio/pause/settings/exit/simultaneous contracts plus real countdown and engine viewport hold/release. Fixed-step input telemetry is simulated time, not framerate. Existing scene fixture uses explicitly staged contacts and scripted controls; no OS or human feel/audio approval. Projection endpoint checks include both directions; screenshot review remains required.
